chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon him), that he was asked about a slave who accused his wife, and he said:
They perform the *li'an* (mutual cursing) just as the free persons perform it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of li'an when a slave accuses his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith from *al-Istibsar* clarifies that the judicial ritual of *li'an* (mutual imprecation) applies equally to slaves and free persons, demonstrating the universality of this evidentiary mechanism in Shia jurisprudence. It underscores that while social status may affect other legal matters, the procedural integrity of *li'an* remains consistent, ensuring justice in cases of adultery accusations regardless of the parties' freedom status.
